article.title: Appeal to Supreme Court.
article.content:
261Appeal to Supreme Court.

Section 261  ·  Chapter XX  ·  D.—Appeals to the Supreme Court  ·  page 900 of the Act
An appeal shall lie to the Supreme Court from any judgment of the High Court delivered on a reference made under section 256 against an order made under section 254 before the 1st day of October, 1998 or an appeal made to High Court in respect of an order passed under section 254 on or after that date in any case which the High Court certifies to be a fit one for appeal to the Supreme Court.
